book_metadata.title: The Art of Chart Interpretation
book_metadata.author: Tracy Marks
book_metadata.edition: Revised and expanded edition (originally The Art of Chart Synthesis)

core_principles.interpretation_philosophy: Focus on most outstanding chart features rather than covering everything; quality over quantity
core_principles.key_principle: Start with characteristics that are most extreme, powerful, and outstanding
core_principles.empowerment_message: Charts are not static; we can direct planetary energies through self-awareness and effort

splash.definition: Planets scattered with no more than 2 per house, no more than 3 empty houses, no empty area >60°

bowl.definition: All planets within 180-190°, one side of opposition, ≤60° empty in occupied portion
bowl.interpretation: Self-contained in occupied houses, focuses on achieving in unoccupied area

bucket.definition: Bowl pattern with handle planet ≥30° from bowl planets

locomotive.definition: All planets within 240-250°, ≤60° empty, trine bridging empty area
locomotive.interpretation: Energetic, self-driving, focused on achieving purpose indicated by empty trine midpoint

seesaw.definition: Planets in two groups ≥60° apart, at least one opposition
seesaw.interpretation: Libra-like, concerned with relationships, balance, alternatives

bundle.interpretation: Self-contained, focused, limited perspective but deep resource development

fan.definition: All but 1-2 planets in bundle trine, singleton ≥60° from bundle opposing at least one planet
fan.interpretation: Uses handle planet as source of support/nourishment

splay.definition: Planets in 3 groups ≥60° apart, connected by grand trine in pure form

stellium.definition: Traditionally 4+ planets within 8° in same sign/house

grand_trine.definition: 3+ planets in same element, each trine the others

elemental_interpretations.fire: Ceaseless energy, difficulty slowing down, understanding others
elemental_interpretations.earth: Successful job application, material resource management, bound by mundane concerns
elemental_interpretations.air: Intellectual/social self-sufficiency, difficulty with emotional/practical issues
elemental_interpretations.water: Active emotional life, high sensitivity, difficulty sharing feelings objectively

yod.definition: Two planets sextile, each inconjunct (150°) a third focal planet
yod.interpretation: Calls for emotional/mental readjustment; focal planet indicates energies needing regeneration

t_square.definition: Two planets in opposition, both square a third focal planet, usually in same mode

interpretation.general: High motivation and achievement potential, but out of balance, leaning tendencies
interpretation.cardinal: Most active, plunges into crises, needs Libran balance
interpretation.fixed: Strong will, concentrated power, builds then releases energy, needs constructive outlets
interpretation.mutable: Over-adaptable, changeable, influenced by relationships, needs sense of purpose

grand_cross.definition: 4+ planets forming four squares and two oppositions, usually same mode

conjunction.interpretation: Self-contained, self-accepting, firm identity, inner power, subjective, may have narrow focus

square.interpretation: Inner tension, will/feelings disharmony, relationship difficulties, high motivation through struggle

sextile_trine.interpretation: Internally consistent, self-accepting, harmonious parents, ease in relationships, may avoid personal challenges

opposition.interpretation: Inner polarity, works out through relationships, seeks balance/compromise, may feel alienated, capable of objectivity

predominant_aspect_types.squares: Crisis-motivated, high achievers, may waste energy
predominant_aspect_types.trines: Easy lives, many talents, may become stuck in comfort
predominant_aspect_types.oppositions: Extremes and contradictions, seekers of meaning, may need to focus energies

aspect_absence.no_trines: At odds with self/others, must invest energy
aspect_absence.no_oppositions: In touch with self, subjective, may benefit from broader perspective

retrograde_planets.general_interpretation: Functions operate inwardly, indirectly, subconsciously; energies not encouraged in youth

count_interpretation.0: Develop skills early, rarely explore psychological process
count_interpretation.4+: Feel alienated, struggle to find niche, develop own value system

planet_keywords.Mercury: Inner-directed mind, self-analytical, literary interests, difficulty communicating
planet_keywords.Venus: Develops own values, self-loving, fearful of intimacy, unconventional relationships
planet_keywords.Mars: Inhibited action, noncompetitive, internal direction, repressed anger
planet_keywords.Jupiter: Philosophical, psychologically attuned, inwardly expansive, rejects conventional beliefs
planet_keywords.Saturn: Inner stamina, self-doubting, solitary, difficulty with authority
planet_keywords.Uranus: Outwardly conventional/inwardly unconventional, alienated, progressive thinking
planet_keywords.Neptune: Creative imagination, escapist, self-deceiving, psychically sensitive
planet_keywords.Pluto: Suppressed desire/anger, alienated, self-destructive, deep psychological insight

lunar_nodes.south_node: Line of least resistance, past strengths/weaknesses, natural but limiting if overused
lunar_nodes.north_node: Life task and purpose, challenging but fulfilling to develop
lunar_nodes.interpretation_guidance: Consider sign, house, aspects, and dispositors of both nodes

synthesis_worksheet.purpose: Systematic method to identify 15-20 important chart characteristics, reduce to 5-8 primary ones
sections: A. The Chart as a Whole (elements, modes, patterns, configurations, Sun/Moon, Asc/MC, retrogrades)
C. Aspects & Other Chart Variables (aspect types, close aspects, minors, parallels, mutual receptions, nodes)
D. Preliminary Synthesis (strongest planets, signs, houses, aspects)
synthesis_worksheet.process: Complete worksheet, reflect 20-30 minutes on significant issues, prepare reading

aims_of_astrologer: Increase self-acceptance and appreciation of uniqueness
Confirm client's sense of self and reality
Help develop viable life philosophy/belief system
Support understanding and action for progress
Impart understanding of cycles and timing
effective_astrologer_qualities: Relates to client first, chart second
Imparts constructive philosophy with long-term perspective

session_structure.initial_contact: Discuss experience, aims, context, explain philosophy/policies
session_structure.session_beginning: Establish rapport, explain chart basics, outline process
guidelines: Keep original goals in mind but modify if needed
Balance depth with breadth of coverage
Check current transits even if not focusing on them
Let client choose focus when in doubt

interpretation_guidelines.what: Most significant chart factors and currently relevant issues
when: When client is groping for deeper insight
how: Suggest tentatively rather than tell authoritatively

when_helpful: Client feels understood and joint exploration has occurred
Client is open, capable, and eager
Client lacks awareness of beneficial options

categories: Confronting passivity or lack of responsibility

example_charts.detailed_interpretation: Liv Ullman's chart analysis demonstrates synthesis principles in practice

additional_considerations.eclipses: Solar (New Moon conjunct nodes) and Lunar (Full Moon conjunct nodes)

house_emphasis.angular: Powerful urge to mobilize energy in major life areas
house_emphasis.succedent: Urge to satisfy personal desires, capacity to follow through
house_emphasis.cadent: Concerned with reactions to experience, conceptualizing reality

eastern_western_division.eastern: 7+ planets east - life in own hands

sun_mercury_conjunction.combust: ½-4° orb - mentally overstimulated, overly subjective
sun_mercury_conjunction.cazimi: <30' orb - intensified power, sharp mind, genius potential

additional_considerations.midpoints: Most significant is midpoint of square conjuncting a planet
